hooks.text: 极速计时与超车等行为持续叠加星星收益
hooks.excerpt: In Incremental Retro Racing you accumulate an ever increasing amount of stars by racing in many ways. Driving top speed, beating the clock, taking over cars, etc.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 赛后星星可改写车辆升级赛道生成与收益规则
hooks.excerpt: After each race you can go into the shop and use stars to unlock new vehicles, upgrades, modifications to track generation, the way you earn stars, and more.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 无限赛道可从窄坡弯路改造成三十车道高速路
hooks.excerpt: You want to drive narrow roads with a maximum of hills and curves? Or long straight 30-lane highways with no traffic? There are unlimited tracks.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 持续提供明确成长目标

excerpts.excerpt: always gives you something to work toward.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 复古赛车与增量成长的组合令人上瘾

excerpts.excerpt: An addictive mix of retro racing and incremental mechanics
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
